data_fields.name: ui_cue_option_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 UI sound paths plus music path

best_idea: Mute feedback cues for the length of a programmatic UI change with a depth counter, and give a capped voice pool a priority steal so a hit cue can take the slot of a lower-priority ambience cue.
decision_why: Take the scope-guard mute and the capped pool; the donor drops any cue when all voices are busy (defect), so the sketch adds a priority steal. Keeps world hit cues audible during HUD rebuilds.
acceptance: When a fight starts and the HUD rebuilds lock-on and list rows, no click plays (a client test asserts a UI cue is skipped inside the rebuild scope while a world cue still plays), and with the voice pool full a hit cue plays while the lowest-priority ambience cue is dropped (a test asserts both).
